text:
maria: Quick idea — can we surface a tiny sparkline next to each audit export row that shows change-event rate over the last 7 days? Compliance asked for a quick signal before downloading 10GB bundles.
kevin: +1, that would help triage. Product Qs: should the sparkline be server-generated PNG, a small inline SVG, or a monospace unicode sparkline? Also, will generation affect export creation latency?
sachin: We already store hourly change counts in telemetry. Prefer precomputed small data + inline svg or unicode to keep payload tiny. PNGs would be heavier and slower. Important: export creation path must be async — don’t block on rendering. Cache sparkline data on export metadata (expired after 24h).
olivia: Important ops note — we need export throttles. We saw a tenant saturate bandwidth with parallel bulk downloads. Proposal: enforce per-tenant daily bytes, a concurrent-download cap (default 3), and make presigned links 1h by default. For long-lived needs we support a staged-bundle flow (mode=staged) where we assemble and put the archive into long-term storage with TTL (7d).
sachin: API sketch — no blocking rendering, add query flags. Example: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit/exports?mode=staged&include_sparkline=true'
```
Telemetry event: `audit.export.requested` with props {tenant_id, export_mode, include_sparkline, requested_by, estimated_size_bytes}. Also emit `audit.export.staged_completed` and `audit.export.presigned_issued`.
maria: UX notes — console: tiny sparkline column, hover tooltip shows avg changes/hr and peak day. For exports >100MB require a short "reason" field before creating the export (helps legal/compliance). Add a visual badge if sensitive assertions will be included.
kevin: Also surface a flag in the export metadata called `sensitive_assertions_present` and default to redacting actor PII (emails) unless tenant feature-flag allows full actor details.
audit-bot: Created issue #4567: "export sparklines + staged bundles + throttles" and added to eng-platform board.
olivia: I'll prototype nginx rate gates for concurrent downloads and add a background job to assemble staged bundles. Will add metric `export.staged.size_bytes` and alert if a single tenant exceeds 10GB/day.
maria: Great — can we sync 30m tomorrow to lock API shape and console placements? @sachin @olivia
